name: searxng
title: SearXNG search
description: Web search through a SearXNG instance of yours (a metasearch engine that asks many search engines at once, without tracking): title, URL, snippet and engines of each result, with category, language, time range and pages. Set SEARXNG_URL to the instance (its JSON format allowed). Needs network to the instance (added with --network full: only SEARXNG_URL is requested).
license: MIT (MCP server, sandbox-ai-mcp); SearXNG itself: AGPL-3.0-or-later

env.name: SEARXNG_URL
env.description: Your SearXNG instance, e.g. https://search.example.org or http://192.168.1.20:8888

notes: Only SEARXNG_URL/search is requested. Run the instance yourself (docs/SEARXNG.md: a hardened container of the official image) or use one you trust; public instances usually refuse the JSON format.
